Class XReportView

java.lang.Object
com.pos.XReportView
public class XReportView extends Object
Displays the ShareTea X Report for the current business day. The report shows total sales, total orders, and average order value. It also displays hourly sales data in a table and bar chart, allowing managers to review sales activity throughout the day.
Author:
Rafael Perez

  • Method Details

    • createXReportPane

      public static javafx.scene.Node createXReportPane()
      Creates the X Report interface for the manager view. Builds the summary cards, hourly sales table, and bar chart. Also adds a refresh button and loads the current day's sales information from the database.
      Returns:
      a JavaFX Node containing the complete X Report interface

    • loadXReport

      private static void loadXReport(javafx.scene.control.Label dateLabel, javafx.scene.control.Label totalSalesValue, javafx.scene.control.Label totalOrdersValue, javafx.scene.control.Label averageOrderValue, javafx.scene.chart.BarChart<String,Number> chart)
      Retrieves sales information for the current business day and updates the X Report interface. Queries the database to calculate hourly sales and order counts. The results are used to update the summary labels, sales table, and bar chart. If a database error occurs, an error message is displayed to the user.
      Parameters:
      dateLabel - label displaying the current business date
      totalSalesValue - label displaying total daily sales
      totalOrdersValue - label displaying total daily orders
      averageOrderValue - label displaying the average order amount
      chart - bar chart displaying hourly sales totals
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if a required label or chart is null

    • createCard

      private static javafx.scene.layout.VBox createCard(String heading, javafx.scene.control.Label value)
      Creates a styled summary card for the X Report. Each card contains a heading and a value, such as total sales, total orders, or average order amount.
      Parameters:
      heading - text displayed at the top of the card
      value - label containing the value displayed in the card
      Returns:
      a VBox containing the formatted summary card
